hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Any number x can be replaced by any divisor present in the array.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The minimum replacement for x is the smallest value in the array that divides x.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Identify the smallest present divisor for each unique value and sum the replacements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Factors each unique value to find its minimal present divisor.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching the array for arbitrary divisors per element takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caches minimal divisors per distinct element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies divisor factorization and greedily picks minimal available divisor.
